theorem sample (p q : Prop) : (p ∧ q) ↔ (q ∧ p) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact And.intro h.right h.left
  · intro h
    exact And.intro h.right h.left
theorem sample (p q r : Prop) : p → ((p ∨ q) ∨ r)
theorem sample (p q r : Prop) : p → ((p ∨ q) ∨ r) := by exact fun h => Or.inl (Or.inl h)
theorem sample (p q : Prop) (h : p ∧ q) : q ∧ p
theorem sample (p q : Prop) (h : p ∧ q) : q ∧ p := by exact And.intro h.right h.left
